title: Mercury DS authored route encounter specification

policy.postgame_routes_225_230: not authored in recovered pre-League pass; intentionally excluded from this port
policy.honey_tree: instant regional premium encounter; no wait; Burmy excluded
policy.great_marsh: curated six-biome ecology; no daily species gate

encounters_route_205_north.identity: Platinum north half: Bidoof/Budew/Wurmple/Silcoon/Cascoon/Kricketot with rare Beautifly/Dustox; Mercury adds a forest-edge riverside layer without replacing those anchors.

encounters_route_216.identity: Snowy treeline and mountain-pass ecology. Platinum Snover/Sneasel/Meditite/Graveler backbone; Mercury introduces cold forest and mountain species.

encounters_route_217.identity: Deep-blizzard tundra. Platinum Snover/Swinub/Sneasel/Snorunt identity; Mercury expands with harsher Ice species distinct from Route 216.

encounters_route_218.identity: Short Surf-heavy fishing route west of Jubilife, transitioning into Canalave maritime/industrial ecology.

encounters_route_219.identity: Platinum small beach route south of Sandgem: no land grass, Surf/fishing only, anchored by Tentacool/Wingull/Tentacruel/Pelipper.

encounters_route_220.identity: Platinum open sea route with small islands. Keeps the Route 219 coastal anchors but shifts toward deeper-water species and stronger fishing targets.

encounters_route_221.identity: Platinum wooded Pal Park approach anchored by Sudowoodo/Girafarig/Roselia/Floatzel. Radar Nidorina/Nidorino and swarm Farfetchd are normalized into authored encounters instead of special RNG.

encounters_route_222.identity: Southeastern Sinnoh coastal route into Sunyshore. Platinum electric/coastal anchors remain, while Mercury adds evolved late-game electric and shoreline species instead of recycling Route 218/213 wholesale.

encounters_route_223.identity: Platinum Route 223 sea route: a fully aquatic final approach from Sunyshore to the Pokemon League, expanded with rare open-water species while retaining Tentacruel/Pelipper/Mantyke as the core.

encounters_route_224.identity: Platinum Route 224: remote forested peninsula with beaches and the White Rock, expanded as a pre-League optional high-level route.
